name: ImGuiWindow.ColorPicker
description: Appends an RGBA color editor to an ImGuiWindow and stores the callback. Missing or nil color components default to 1.0. When the editor changes, the callback receives red, green, blue, and alpha.

parameters.name: red
parameters.description: Initial red component. Defaults to 1.0 when omitted or nil.

parameters.name: green
parameters.description: Initial green component. Defaults to 1.0 when omitted or nil.

parameters.name: blue
parameters.description: Initial blue component. Defaults to 1.0 when omitted or nil.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Initial alpha component. Defaults to 1.0 when omitted or nil.

parameters.name: onChange
parameters.description: Callback invoked with red, green, blue, and alpha after a color change.
